description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class for the sample app, managing UI fragments and logging.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that initializes and manages a fragment, menu options, and logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets the activity's layout and initializes the fragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu item visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, particularly toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging infrastructure with wrappers, filters, and a log fragment.
